correctness.rationale: Smooth real l_p orthogonality gives an exhaustive signed-coordinate reduction to one compact ratio. F(2,r)=0 and uniform p-differentiability yield the unique maximizer of g(r). Explicit symbolic differentiation and high-precision independent numerical evaluations verify the signed second derivative K(r). A strict nondegenerate maximum plus implicit-function theorem proves local global uniqueness and optimizer drift; Taylor expansion proves the O(|p-2|^3) error. A standalone checker executed successfully for symbolic identities, nine high-precision ratios, six optimized p-values and boundaries. The finite checks are not a substitute for the analytic proof.
